q1_what_did_you_play: I played Bang Bang! at Seapunk, then Fwoosh! at Seapunk, then Kaboom! at Seapunk, then Duck and Cover. This spends all 3 Spark and 2 Energy, deals 25 total damage to Seapunk, and gains 5 Block before the telegraphed 11 damage attack.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Firework Finale, then Kaboom!, then Duck and Cover. That line also deals 25 total damage and gains 5 Block, but it Exhausts Firework Finale and uses one larger hit instead of Bang Bang! plus Fwoosh!.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the chance to Exhaust Firework Finale and to deal the 18 damage as a single hit. It also leaves 1 Energy unused, though the main alternative did as well. In exchange, it avoids Exhausting Firework Finale and uses the two non-Exhaust Spark cards instead.
q4_different_intent: No. The chosen line already takes the maximum available damage and the available Block without sacrificing damage. A different telegraphed attack would make the Block more or less important, but it would not change the fact that this line is damage-maximal and still affordable. A non-attack intent would not make the Block harmful based on the information given.
